cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Accepted contestant sibling PDF SHA-256 4900dabfa70aba691f1dfb3575ab4ae5daa08c5a7c19cbacf63a48164ff222ac p27 reports mean Cd≈1.1233, lift amplitude ±0.2426 and St≈0.1611, correcting previous false missing-summary claim. PDF pp27–30 show residual history, wake contours and force history; high-resolution inspection of p28 shows both late lift and small resolved drag oscillations with startup clipped, correcting old missing-late-plot claim. Original t≥150 forces.csv mean Cd=1.123268, Cl range −0.240739–0.244489; 24 upward mean-lift crossings give 23 periods averaging 6.20753, frequency≈0.1611. Report.tex:151–153 and solver/src/fvsolver_run.cpp:485–491 disclose a 4-degree farfield perturbation only for t=2–12; reported zero target misses are recorded by actual ratio test (:495–511). Score 2→3: floor met, but shedding amplitude, frequency and drag underpredict cited references and no independent grid convergence is shown. Missing curated figure assets remain a report-reproducibility issue. No Re200 rerun.
